title: Regularity of strict henselization divisor quotient
statement: Let R be a commutative regular ring and f in R such that R/(f) is regular. Let Ω be an algebraically closed field and barY : Spec Ω → Spec R a geometric point. Let b : R → strictHenselizationRing barY induce the canonical strict henselization structural morphism on spectra. If b(f) is not a unit, then strictHenselizationRing barY/(b(f)) is regular.

proof.text: Use the canonical small-to-full affine-colimit comparison. Its coprojection formula identifies the structural maps; composing b with its forward map preserves the nonunit condition, as witnessed by its inverse. Apply the upstream Noetherianity and prime-local regularity theorem to this composite, then assemble IsRegularRing on the full-colimit quotient. Ideal.quotientEquiv for the inverse comparison identifies its principal quotient with the original small-colimit quotient. Transport regularity by Mathlib IsRegularRing.of_ringEquiv.
